part: VONVOFF (DONJON) 433 MHz RF remote switch kit
key_specs: 433 MHz learning-code; AC 100-240 V single phase; 30 A rated on a 40 A relay; 328 ft; 4 terminals as AC IN L/N + AC OUT L/N; modes point-movement / self-locking / interlock (interlock is the factory default)
notes: MUST be set to momentary (1 learn press) before use. LINE-POWERED: AC IN L is both its supply and the line side of its relay, so it stays permanently live and the unit sits at the head of the rung. AC OUT L is switched AC IN L — NOT a dry contact; the N pair is a bonded common bus. Do NOT copy the manufacturer diagram's direct-to-coil wiring: it bypasses the seal-in and violates SR-4. Listing claims Contact Type Normally Closed — verify by observation. Repurposes to dust collection once TASK-3 lands.
